description: Flow Problem Exchange solver record, served at GET /api/exchange/solver?id=<solver>. A record is minted only from real exchange outcomes: it is created at a solver's first assignment with all counts zero, and solved / failed / graded counts move ONLY on real verdict-engine grades — an assignment alone earns nothing. A solver with no graded history has no record: the endpoint answers 404, never a fabricated card.

failed.description: Graded solves whose proof failed the verdict.

graded.description: Total solves graded by the verdict engine.

id.description: Solver id as it appears on listings (e.g. flowexecutor).

solved.description: Graded solves with a passing verdict.

title: exchange-solver-record/0.1
